name: kimi-pet-bridge
description: KimiPet 转发器（kimi-pet-bridge）与进程间通信协议包。对应 docs/MVP设计.md §3/§4

scripts.build:exe: npm run build && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('bin',{recursive:true})" && bun build --compile --windows-hide-console dist/launcher/main.js --outfile bin/kimi-petd.exe
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-force-exit dist-test/test/
